lines: Rafta rafta woh meri hasti ka saamaan ho gaye.
couplets.en: Little by little, you became all that sustained me.

lines: Pehle jaan, phir jaan-e-jaan, phir jaan-e-jaanaan ho gaye.
couplets.en: First you were my life, then the life within it, then my dearest beloved.

lines: Rafta rafta woh meri hasti ka saamaan ho gaye.
couplets.en: Little by little, you became all that sustained me.

lines: Din-ba-din badhti gayin is husn ki ranaaiyaan.
couplets.en: Day by day, your beauty grew more radiant.

lines: Din-ba-din badhti gayin is husn ki ranaaiyaan.
Pehle gul, phir gul-badan, phir gul-badaamaan ho gaye.
couplets.en: Day by day your beauty deepened, from a rose to a rose in human form, then to a beloved with roses in your skirt.

lines: Rafta rafta woh meri hasti ka saamaan ho gaye.

lines: Aap to nazdeek se nazdeek-tar aate gaye.
Aap to nazdeek se nazdeek-tar aate gaye.
Pehle dil, phir dil-ruba, phir dil ke mehmaan ho gaye.
couplets.en: You drew ever closer, first my heart, then its captor, then its guest.

lines: Rafta rafta woh meri hasti ka saamaan ho gaye.

lines: Aap se phir tum hue, phir tu ka unwaan ho gaye.
couplets.en: Even my way of saying you grew tender, from aap to tum to tu.
